{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "on: 
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

name: Continuous integration

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust:
          - stable
          - beta
          - nightly
          - 1.93.1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3.5.0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
          components: clippy, rustfmt
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.2.1
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt -- --check
        if: ${{ matrix.rust == 'nightly' }}
      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy
        env:
          RUSTFLAGS: -Dwarnings
        continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.rust == 'nightly' || matrix.rust == 'beta' }}
      - name: Install "build all features"
        run: cargo install cargo-all-features --version 1.12.0 --force --locked
      - name: Build all features
        run: cargo build-all-features
      - name: Test all features
        run: cargo test-all-features -- --nocapture
        env:
          RUST_TEST_THREADS: 3 # So the parallel tests have enough threads
          RUST_LOG: debug

  multi-os-testing:
    name: Test suite
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - windows-latest
          - macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3.5.0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.2.1
      - name: Build and test
        run: cargo test --all-features -- --nocapture
        env:
          RUST_TEST_THREADS: 3 # So the parallel tests have enough threads
          RUST_LOG: debug

  miri:
    name: Miri
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3.5.0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: nightly
          components: miri
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.2.1
      - name: Miri strict provenance
        run: cargo miri test -p serial_test --all-features -- --skip file_lock
        env:
          MIRIFLAGS: -Zmiri-strict-provenance

  minimal-versions:
    name: minimal versions check
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3.5.0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: nightly
      - name: Remove lock
        run: rm Cargo.lock
      - run: cargo build -Z minimal-versions
    
  dependency-updates:
    name: dependency updates
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3.5.0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      - name: Update packages
        run: cargo update
      - name: Build and test
        run: cargo test --all-features -- --nocapture
        env:
          RUST_TEST_THREADS: 3 # So the parallel tests have enough threads
          RUST_LOG: debug

  # As per https://github.com/dtolnay/cargo-docs-rs?tab=readme-ov-file#example
  doc:
    name: Documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      RUSTDOCFLAGS: -Dwarnings
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.2.1
      - uses: dtolnay/install@cargo-docs-rs
      - run: cargo docs-rs -p serial_test
      - run: cargo docs-rs -p serial_test_derive

  audit:
    name: Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - run: cargo install cargo-audit --locked
      - run: cargo audit --deny warnings

  version-lint:
    name: Version lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: tombi-toml/setup-tombi@v1.5.2
      - name: Check TOML format
        run: tombi format --check
      - name: Validate TOML files
        run: tombi lint     

  # Placeholder to be marked as required in PRs and which depends on all other steps
  finish:
      needs: [test, audit, doc, dependency-updates, minimal-versions, miri, multi-os-testing, version-lint]
      runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
      steps:
          - name: Done
            run: echo "All finished"",
  "rationale": "The doc job runs cargo docs-rs, which fetches and builds dependencies, but lacks dependency caching while the same repository already uses Swatinem/rust-cache in the test, multi-os-testing, and miri jobs. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and its measured experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) show that caching dependency downloads reduces CI time (6.06% elapsed savings) without changing test coverage. Adding Swatinem/rust-cache@v2.2.1 to the doc job is a minimal, consistent change that preserves all required checks, introduces no new network access or privileged actions, and reuses an already-approved action in the workflow.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
